question:
**Direction: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.**

Absorb
solution:
The correct answer is **"Dismiss."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Absorb"** means to take in or soak up. ((द्रव पदार्थ, ताप आदि को) अपने में सोख लेना; अवशोषित करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *That liquid **absorbed**__ the moisture.*
 
 
 
• **"Dismiss"** means to reject or disregard. (किसी बात को ख़ारिज कर देना, सोच-विचार के लायक़ न मानना)
 __
 
• **Example**:* **I think he'd **dismissed**__ me as an idiot within five minutes of meeting me.*
 
 
 
• **Dismiss** is the opposite in meaning of **Absorb**.
 
• The correct answer is option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Dwindle** means to gradually decrease in size or amount. (कम होना, घट जाना, क्रमिक रूप से कम या क्षीण होते जाना)
 
• **Permit** means to allow or give permission. (किसी बात की अनुमति देना या कोई बात होने देना)
 
• **Reconcile** means to restore friendly relations between two parties. (परस्‍पर विपरीत प्रतीत होने वाली स्थितियों में ताल-मेल बैठाना)
